Be it ordained by the Mayor and Council of the Town of Pine Mountain, that the Traffic Control Ordinance be amended by adding the following: Location No. 1: Begin no parking on the West side of State Route 1 (US 27) at O.E. White's Driveway, milepost 20.65 and extending to the South for a distance of 150 feet. Location No. 2: No parking for a distance of 200 feet either side of milepost 21.00 on the East side of State Route 1, State Route 18, and US 27 in front of Parker Chevrolet Company.

This the 10th day of January 1977.

The following council members Yoted on this ordinance:

James M. Chambers Aye A.D. Davis Aye James V. Edgar Aye . Vance C. Smith Aye

Mrs. Evelyn M. Hargett Absent
